sloka: जानीषे त्वम् जनस्थाने भ्राता यत्र खरो मम ।दूषणः च महाबाहुः स्वसा शूर्पणखा च मे ॥३-३६-२॥
transliteration: jānīṣe tvam janasthāne bhrātā yatra kharo mama ।dūṣaṇaḥ ca mahābāhuḥ svasā śūrpaṇakhā ca me ॥3-36-2॥

translations.english: You know that my brothers, Khara and Dusana, the strongarmed heroes, my sister Surpanakha and the mighty cannibal Trisira, and many other heroic demons successful in hitting their targets are bonafide residents. They have been harassing the followers of righteous path (the sages) at my behest.
translations.hindi: हे तात माळ में जो य हूँ उसे आप सुनिए । इस समय बहुत दुःखा हूं आर आप ही मेरा इस दःख ला इस दुःख से निस्तार कर जानीषे त्वं जनस्थाने यथा भ्राता खरो सम । दूषणश्च महाबाहुः स्वसा शूपेणखा च मे
